interpretation: Conditional scenarios explicitly approved by user. These ranges are hypothetical input choices, not confidence intervals or guaranteed achievable gains. Do not add them or use them as recorded target support.

modeledGain.assumption: If half to all of the reference speed advantage is recovered, without losing speed elsewhere.
modeledGain.method: Conditional fixed-distance integral of 1/v over this section using aligned recorded GPS speed (m/s). Only positive support speed differences are applied; slower support regions are held at your baseline. This hybrid speed envelope is not a demonstrated lap, confidence interval or achievable forecast. Line, traction, acceleration feasibility and effects on adjacent sections are unverified; scenarios overlap and must not be added.

modeledGain.assumption: If recovery to +1 m/s needs 25–50% less distance, assuming sufficient acceleration/traction.
modeledGain.method: Hypothetical recovery distance 5.3–7.9 m instead of 10.6 m. Conditional fixed-distance integral of 1/v over the measured minimum-to-+1 m/s window. Compress the recorded speed-versus-distance shape into 75% and 50% of that window, then hold its recorded final speed to the original endpoint. Minimum speed, final speed and all speeds outside the window are preserved; no profile extrapolation. No faster lap validates this scenario, and the recovery duration is not time saved. Scenario choices are not confidence bounds or an achievable forecast; dynamics and adjacent-section effects are unverified. Do not add to other scenarios.
